blocks.text:
You can add several excursions to the main programme in Iguazu. Macuco Safari combines a journey through the forest with a trip on the river. You first travel in an open vehicle, then continue on foot to the riverbank and by motorboat. The boat gets close enough to the falls for the spray to become part of the ride. Please ask us for the price.

The Bird Park is next to the national park. In its large aviaries, birds can fly freely among the trees and paths. You can see colourful tropical species, including macaws and toucans. Please ask us for the admission price. Another option is a helicopter flight over Iguazu, which reveals the bend of the river and the cascades from above. Please ask us for the price.

blocks.text:
Your journey to the Amazon begins with a flight to Manaus, followed by a boat trip to Eco Lodge Evolution. From the boat, the cityscape soon disappears and the river and forest become your main landmarks. The next day, a naturalist guide leads the group through the jungle, pointing out plants you might otherwise overlook.

A visit to a caboclo house introduces you to local daily life and traditions, including how manioc flour is made. In the village of Acajatuba, residents fish and farm, growing manioc, tucumã, açaí, palms and Brazil nuts, and using natural seeds to make handicrafts. This gives you a chance to see the Amazon as a place where people live alongside the river and forest every day, as well as a natural reserve.
